answer.rationale: P99 latency is 5x target and isolated to primary region during peak settlement traffic. Rollback is blocked by compliance (security patch immovable). Regional failover has the fastest historical recovery path (memory_b2: clean traffic shift, latency recovery within minutes, no error rate impact) and preserves the required security release. Capacity addition is slower under peak load. Circuit breaker protects checkout but doesn't restore latency on the write path. Read replica routing helps dashboard load but not transactional writes. Failover is the only single intervention that addresses the regional degradation, maintains the security posture, and has proven recovery time at this organization.
